reference: A moment ago she stopped the globe with her hand.
acceptable: {A moment|A minute|A second|A little while} ago she stopped the globe with her hand.
She stopped the globe with her hand {a moment|a minute|a second|a little while} ago.
She stopped the globe with her hand just now.

mistakes.text: A moment ago she stops the globe with her hand.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „a moment ago“ patrí Past Simple: „stopped“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „a moment ago“ patří Past Simple: „stopped“.

mistakes.text: A moment ago she has stopped the globe with her hand.
mistakes.feedback_sk: S „ago“ nepoužívaj Present Perfect, patrí tu Past Simple: „stopped“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: S „ago“ nepoužívej Present Perfect, patří sem Past Simple: „stopped“.

mistakes.text: A moment ago she stoped the globe with her hand.
Before a moment she stopped the globe with her hand.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Pred chvíľou“ je „a moment ago“, nie „before a moment“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Před chvílí“ je „a moment ago“, ne „before a moment“.

mistakes.text: A moment ago she stopped the globe by her hand.
A moment ago she stopped the globe with hand.
